entries.reason: No zod 3.x fix (only 4.6.6). zod 3.x z.array without a length limit collects one issue per bad item; @ton/ton HttpApi parses toncenter responses with 7 such arrays. The worker uses only TonClient/HttpApi (not TonClient4). Mitigation D-60 (4): HTTPS to the configured endpoint only, no redirects or proxy, response <= 2 MiB (worst case measured ~340 MB heap, worker limit 768 MB). DoS only, no money out. Revisit before mainnet.
